title: Tensor product of a separably generated field extension with a reduced algebra is reduced
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $S$ be a reduced $k$-algebra (a commutative $k$-algebra with no nonzero nilpotent elements), and let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] which is separably generated over $k$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (1): there is a transcendence basis $(x_i)_{i\in I}$ of $K/k$ such that $K/k(x_i;i\in I)$ is separable algebraic. Then the ring $K\otimes_kS$ (the tensor product of the $k$-algebras $K$ and $S$, with multiplication $(a\otimes s)(a'\otimes s')=aa'\otimes ss'$ and unit $1\otimes1$) is reduced.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 030U (lemma-separable-extension-preserves-reducedness, line 10152), the case 'K/k separably generated' (second paragraph of its proof, which reduces to the finitely generated separably generated case treated in the first paragraph); the case 'K/k separable' of 030U is not part of this node

proof.text: Unpack IsSeparablyGenerated as a set s whose inclusion is a transcendence basis and such that K is separable algebraic over E = IntermediateField.adjoin k s. Only algebraic independence of the basis is needed below. All subsequent steps are implemented in the compiling Lean proof, using the closed source and Mathlib declarations named explicitly in these steps.

The proved source theorem isReduced_tensorProduct_of_forall_residueField reduces reducedness of S tensor E to reducedness of kappa(p) tensor E for every prime p of S. This theorem uses joint injectivity of the residue-field maps, preserved by tensoring a vector space (a basis argument), rather than commuting tensor products with an infinite product. Apply the proved source theorem isReduced_tensorProduct_adjoin_of_algebraicIndependent to the inclusion of s, then rewrite Subtype.range_coe_subtype. It identifies the tensor with a localization of a polynomial ring over kappa(p), which is reduced. This works for an arbitrary, possibly empty or infinite, basis. Tensor commutativity then gives IsReduced (E tensor S). Both source declarations are in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.Nilpotent.GeometricallyReduced; their proofs are closed, and no new unproved statement is used.

Prove the private helper isReduced_tensorProduct_of_separable_algebraic for a separable algebraic extension L/k and any reduced k-algebra A. Commute the tensor and apply the same residue-field reduction to A. For each residue field F, apply Mathlib IsReduced.tensorProduct_of_flat_of_forall_fg to F tensor L. For a finitely generated k-subalgebra B of L, use Subalgebra.isField_of_algebraic to equip its actual underlying commutative ring with the field structure; this is a proved property, not an arbitrary existence witness. Algebra.IsSeparable.of_algHom k L B.val proves separability of B. Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType gives finite type, hence essentially finite type. Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_isSeparable gives formal unramifiedness of B/k. Its base change F tensor B is formally unramified and essentially finite type over the field F, so Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field makes it reduced. Finite-subalgebra reduction and tensor commutativity conclude. The helper is proved in full with no sorry.

Apply the helper with base E, field extension K and reduced E-algebra E tensor S. This proves reducedness of K tensor over E (E tensor over k S). The inverse of Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange k E K K S is an injective algebra equivalence from K tensor over k S to this reduced ring. Apply isReduced_of_injective to conclude exactly the original statement.
